T2M.label: Monthly forecast — Temperature at 2 Meters (12 months)
findings: Temperature at 2 Meters: the selected models beat climatology on held-out 2018–2025 data at horizons 1, 2, 3, 4 month(s) (MAE skill up to 26%). Beyond that, forecasts carry no more information than the monthly climatology.
80% prediction intervals covered 69%–78% of held-out observations across horizons (nominal 80%).
assumptions: Monthly statistics are stationary apart from a linear trend over 1981–2025
MERRA-2 reanalysis adequately represents the regional monthly climate
limitations: ~50 km cells: one cell covers all of Bengaluru; no neighbourhood-scale prediction.
Forecast issued from the last ACQUIRED month (Dec 2025); 2026 months already elapsed can be verified once acquired.
Not a weather forecast and not a climate projection.
T2M.uncertainty: Intervals describe historical out-of-sample error of this statistical model; they are not climate-scenario uncertainty.
T2M.basis: FPP3 (Hyndman & Athanasopoulos 2021); Tashman 2000; Lei et al. 2018

PRECTOTCORR.label: Monthly forecast — Precipitation Corrected (12 months)
findings: Precipitation Corrected: no candidate model beats climatology on held-out data; the forecast is effectively the monthly climatology.
80% prediction intervals covered 75%–77% of held-out observations across horizons (nominal 80%).
assumptions: Monthly statistics are stationary apart from a linear trend over 1981–2025
MERRA-2 reanalysis adequately represents the regional monthly climate
limitations: ~50 km cells: one cell covers all of Bengaluru; no neighbourhood-scale prediction.
Forecast issued from the last ACQUIRED month (Dec 2025); 2026 months already elapsed can be verified once acquired.
Not a weather forecast and not a climate projection.
Precipitation forecasts clipped at 0 mm/day (physical bound).
PRECTOTCORR.uncertainty: Intervals describe historical out-of-sample error of this statistical model; they are not climate-scenario uncertainty.
PRECTOTCORR.basis: FPP3 (Hyndman & Athanasopoulos 2021); Tashman 2000; Lei et al. 2018
